Demo._comment: Turn on for a sales/demo deployment: the portal and public site then show a 'demonstration site, available to buy' banner. Independent of ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT and of the payment/SMS sandbox modes.

Accounts._comment: Public https origin of this API (activation/reset links point at /account/* here) and the staff portal URL. Required in Production.

Mfa._comment: AES-256 keys (base64, 32 bytes) that encrypt staff authenticator secrets. Supply from a secret store, never the 'dev' key; keep old key ids listed after rotating (ADR 0016).

Cors._comment: Portal origin(s) allowed to open the notifications hub cross-origin, e.g. https://portal.example.co.ke

Clients.ClientName: Member mobile app (native phone+PIN, member only)

IdentityServer._comment: Production sets SigningCredential=Certificate plus CertificateBase64/CertificatePath from the secrets manager; the host refuses to start otherwise.

Payments._comment: Mode=Live plus credentials from the secrets manager switches a provider; see docs/integrations/payment-providers.md and docs/runbooks/production-cutover.md
